meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 执行 OneCLI Agent Vault 的安装与初始化:检测现有凭据,把 .env 里的 Anthropic 等密钥迁入 OneCLI 保管,移除 .env 中的明文密钥,随后重建并重启 NanoClaw 服务,最后检查日志确认网关生效。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 变更后,或首次设置 OneCLI 需要从头配置时,运行 /init-onecli 触发。

say.note: 开始安装并初始化 OneCLI。

say.text: 初始化 OneCLI,并把 .env 里的密钥迁进去
刚更新完 nanoclaw,重跑一次 /init-onecli
say.note: 按变更后的流程重新配置。

howto.what_en: Installs and initializes OneCLI Agent Vault: checks current setup, migrates Anthropic and other container-facing credentials from .env into the vault, removes plaintext keys, rebuilds and restarts the service, verifies gateway logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /init-onecli when /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or when OneCLI needs first-time setup from scratch.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI and migrate .env keys into it
say_en.note: Anthropic keys move to the vault and are removed from .env.
